specs.Connector Type Used on Cable: USB Type A, USB Type C
specs.Item Type Name: Wireless Adapter for CarPlay & Android Auto

features: 【WIRELESS CARPLAY CONVERSION】 Converts your car's wired Apple CarPlay into a fully wireless setup. Plug the N70 into the USB port once, and from then on your iPhone connects automatically. No daily cable routine, no fumbling with lightning connectors before you can pull out of the driveway.

【WIRELESS ANDROID AUTO CONVERSION】 Same adapter, same wireless experience for Android phones. Android Auto streams to your car display without any cable. One device handles both platforms, useful for households with mixed iPhone and Android users sharing the same car.

【DUAL-BAND WI-FI 2.4GHz + 5GHz】 Two Wi-Fi bands working together for a faster, more stable connection than single-band adapters. 5GHz handles data-heavy tasks like navigation and music streaming. 2.4GHz keeps the connection reliable. Less interference, smoother performance, fewer dropouts.

【BLUETOOTH AUTO-CONNECT】 Pairs with your phone via Bluetooth, then switches to Wi-Fi automatically. After the first setup, the N70 connects on its own every time you start the car. Phone stays in your pocket, drive begins. No manual pairing required.

【PREMIUM GLASS FINISH BUILD】 A glass-finish housing that looks the part of a premium accessory. Sits cleanly on the dashboard or centre console without looking like a wire-trailing afterthought. Built for buyers who care how the inside of their car looks.

【OEM CONTROLS RETAINED】 Steering wheel buttons, dashboard knobs, and your car's original audio system all keep working exactly as before. The N70 sits between your phone and the car's existing setup without replacing or interfering with what's already there.

【ONLINE OTA UPDATES】 Receives over-the-air software updates so the adapter keeps improving over time. New features, fixes, and compatibility tweaks arrive automatically through the companion app. Future-proofed against software changes from Apple and Google.

【BROAD COMPATIBILITY】 Works with iOS 10 and above, Android 11 and above. Compatible with any car that already has wired CarPlay or Android Auto built in. Note: the N70 upgrades existing functionality, it doesn't add CarPlay or Android Auto to cars that don't already have it.
